rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from ACPE-accredited providers or sponsors approved by the South Dakota Board of Pharmacy; programs approved by another state's board of pharmacy may be accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed pharmacists: 1 hour per month from registration until license expiration.
rules.alternatives: For good cause the Board may grant an extension of up to six months.
rules.audit_note: The Board audits at least 5% of licensed pharmacists at random each year. Keep CE records 3 years from completion.
rules.notes: 12 approved hours required for each yearly renewal, earned within the 24 months before the license expires. Renewals due annually before September 30. Immunization-certified pharmacists need 1 hour of immunization CE (may be one of the 12).
rules.rule_quote: To qualify for a renewal of a pharmacist license or reinstatement, a pharmacist must complete twelve hours of approved continuing education. The twelve hours of approved continuing education required each year for renewal must be completed within the twenty-four months before the pharmacist's license expires.

topics.who: Immunization-certified pharmacists (may be one of the 12)
